purpose: Make the rectangular full sea chart a concise interactive planning surface for existing current-sector targets while preserving the round gameplay minimap and all existing navigation/target/tracking authorities.

locks.secondary_view: region/map overview remains available without replacing current-sector detail
locks.world_truth: only nodes that currently exist in the active world may become interactive chart targets
locks.combat_authority: TargetingSystem remains authoritative for hostile selection
locks.tracking_authority: TrackedQuestRuntime remains authoritative for objective track/untrack
locks.platform_parity: same chart targets/actions/world on mobile, web and desktop; responsive dimensions only

interaction.tap_marker: select existing target and expose a compact context card
interaction.close: returns directly to gameplay without changing the world
